lines.arrive: A clear night. More stars than anyone could count.
lines.arrive_2: In the hut, the receiver is on. It always is.
lines.listen: Only static. The hiss of the stars.
lines.stars: Billions of stars, and around most of them, planets.
lines.old: Some are far older than the Sun. Someone should have come by now.
lines.choose: You could sit here and keep listening. Or you could call out.
lines.not_yet: Not yet. First, hear what the receiver hears.
lines.year_10: Ten years. Maybe they're rare. Maybe they don't last.
lines.year_40: Forty years. Maybe they're quiet. Maybe we're early.
lines.send_1: Your message leaves at the speed of light.
lines.send_2: Years pass. It has barely left the neighbourhood.
lines.send_3: From the nearest star, an answer would take eight years. From most, thousands.
lines.send_4: Nothing yet. Maybe no one heard. Or someone did, and is deciding whether to answer.
lines.logbook: The log goes back years. Every night, the same word: nothing. Except one night, near the end. Heard something. Didn't answer.
lines.logbook_again: The log goes back years. Every night, nothing. And one new line, near the end. Yours.
lines.tea: Your tea has gone cold. It always does, out here.
lines.moon: Only one other world has ever had footprints. Twelve people walked there, and came home.
